risks.risk: Resistance/drive may not work smoothly (belt/chain, flywheel, magnetic resistance, or adjustment mechanism). The photo doesn’t show operation.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing the bike being pedaled at low and high resistance, plus a close-up of the resistance control/adjustment while it changes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume resistance may be weak or noisy.

risks.risk: Console/sensors (if any) may be missing or non-functional; photo doesn’t show a readable console.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console area and a video showing it powering on and displaying speed/time/resistance (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console/sensors not working or not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Fit/parts condition: seat height adjustment, handlebar adjustment, pedals/straps, and any safety covers may be worn or loose.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of seat adjustment track, handlebar adjustment, pedal/strap condition, and any bolts/connection points (both sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price as average wear with possible minor missing/loose parts.

risks.risk: Frame stability and alignment: wobble or bent frame can’t be confirmed from a single angled photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a video clip from the front and side while someone pedals (showing no wobble) and a quick shake test of the handlebars/seat post.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if alignment/stability is unknown.

proof_requests: Video: pedaling at low and high resistance with the resistance control changing (show smoothness/no grinding).
Clear photos of any brand/model plate or serial number (console area + frame).
Close-ups: seat height adjustment, handlebar adjustment, pedals/straps, and resistance mechanism area.
Video: console power-on (if present) showing any readings.
response.reason: The item type is clear (spinning fitness bike), but the photo doesn’t provide the key details needed to price confidently (brand/model, and whether resistance/console work).
